A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Asparagus**:

**Ingredients:** 2 chicken breasts, 1 bunch asparagus, 3 garlic cloves (minced), 1 lemon (zested & juiced), olive oil, salt, pepper, optional red pepper flakes.

**Method:** 
1. Pound chicken to even thickness. Season generously.
2. Sear 4–5 min/side in hot skillet with oil. Remove.
3. Toss asparagus in same pan, cook 3–4 min. Add garlic, cook 30 sec.
4. Deglaze with lemon juice + ¼ cup water. Return chicken to pan, warm through.
5. Finish with lemon zest and parsley. Serve with microwave rice or crusty bread.

**Time:** 20 minutes, one pan, minimal cleanup.
